reviews.text: I often leave my dog ​​there and it always goes very well. The staff is very attentive.
We finally found a place where our rabbit always returns home very well cared for and the service is truly 5-star. I highly recommend it!

I have left my dog 3 times for 7 days+ in the Hotel Monsanto Pet. They were regularly sending pictures, videos and taking a very good care of him. I am extremely happy about the service and how welcoming the team is!

I found out about this place through a coworker and, since then, I've been leaving my furry daughter there, both for daytime and overnight stays. The entire team, from reception to caregivers, is tireless and extremely attentive. I'm so grateful to have met you and for you taking such good care of the most energetic dog in the world. Thank you! ❤️
My dogs love the after-school program, the people who welcome them and spend the day taking care of them. The staff is 5 stars! We highly recommend it.
